title: U.S. House · Alabama's 5th Congressional District
area: North Alabama, including Huntsville, Madison, Decatur, and the Tennessee Valley.

context.text: Incumbent Dale Strong (R) advanced without a primary after his Republican primary was canceled. Andrew Sneed defeated Candice Duvieilh 78.4% to 21.6% in the June 16, 2026 Democratic primary runoff, after the two advanced from a three-way May 19 primary. Cook Political Report rated the district R+15 for 2026.

candidates.name: Dale Strong
candidates.ballotNote: Advanced from the Republican primary unopposed after the primary was canceled.
candidates.currentRole: U.S. Representative for Alabama's 5th Congressional District (since 2023)

priorities.text: Describes himself as a "Trump Conservative" who says taking Republican control of Congress is central to his campaign.
Says cutting wasteful federal spending and reducing the national debt should be a top priority, pointing to his record balancing the Madison County budget as commission chairman.

positions.summary: Says he will always support law enforcement and, as Madison County Commission chairman, raised starting pay for sheriff's deputies.
Campaign website says he fully supports building the wall, sending people in the country illegally back to their country of origin, and fully enforcing the law.
positions.quote: I fully support building the wall, sending illegals back to their country of origin, and fully enforcing the law on those that are in our country illegally.

positions.summary: Cosponsored H.R. 7296, the SAVE America Act, which requires documentary proof of U.S. citizenship to register to vote in federal elections and photo identification to vote.

record.text: Chairs the House Homeland Security Subcommittee on Emergency Management and Technology and serves as Vice Chair of the Appropriations Subcommittee on Commerce, Justice, Science and Related Agencies in the 119th Congress (2025-2026).

Served as Vice Chairman of the Homeland Security Subcommittee on Emergency Preparedness, Response and Recovery, and on the House Committee on Armed Services and Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, in the 118th Congress (2023-2024).

candidates.name: Andrew Sneed
candidates.ballotNote: Won the June 16, 2026 Democratic primary runoff, 78.4% to 21.6%, over Candice Duvieilh.

priorities.text: Affordability, healthcare, job stability, and public education, including repealing tariffs and reforming the tax code so that wealthy earners "pay their fair share."
Restoring Affordable Care Act subsidies, comprehensive insurance reform, and revitalizing rural healthcare.

Government-accountability reforms, including a personal "Balance/Accountability" pledge covering congressional term limits, repealing Citizens United, banning stock trading by members of Congress, and an enforceable Supreme Court ethics code.

positions.summary: Says he is committed to restoring ACA subsidies, comprehensive insurance reform, and revitalizing rural healthcare.
Says changing the tax code to ensure the wealthy pay their fair share is part of his platform.
Lists "repealing harmful tariffs" among his proposed solutions to affordability issues.
